predictions.theory_scope: Restricted S4PR overlap only: finite-LTS prefix agreement plus exact equality between the mapped CRP resource set and the independently generated IMS closed blocking core.
required_evidence: valid hash-bound S4PR embedding
complete finite-LTS reachability audit within the frozen bound
IMS closed-blocking-kernel certificate on the frozen target snapshot
exact mapped resource-set comparison
predictions.falsifier: The target is unreachable, the external prefix claim disagrees with complete BFS, no IMS certificate is generated, or the mapped CRP and IMS resource sets differ.
predictions.scoring_rule: Score true exactly when all four required-evidence checks succeed and the mapped CRP resource set equals the IMS core resource set; otherwise score false.

predictions.theory_scope: A supplied S4PR/CRP-shaped structural candidate is retained, but no IMS deadlock or supervisor benefit is claimed without a legal executable prefix.
required_evidence: valid hash-bound S4PR embedding
candidate target present in the frozen state universe
complete finite-LTS BFS within the frozen bound
explicit false external-prefix claim
predictions.falsifier: Complete BFS reaches the candidate target, the candidate is absent from the frozen state set, or the supplied evidence profile is incomplete.
predictions.scoring_rule: Score true exactly when the candidate is present in the declared state universe, complete bounded BFS does not reach it, and the external-prefix claim is false; otherwise score false.

predictions.theory_scope: The CRP comparator must refuse an exact OR-of-AND, multi-capacity, AGV and hard-reservation generator unless a separate S4PR embedding is supplied.
required_evidence: exact versioned boundary generator
explicit AGV and reservation resources
OR alternatives containing conjunctive resource demands
absence of a supplied S4PR embedding
predictions.falsifier: The generated boundary lacks any declared non-S4PR feature or a complete S4PR embedding is supplied and verified.
predictions.scoring_rule: Score true exactly when the generator materializes every declared boundary feature and the CRP comparator returns not_applicable without an embedding; otherwise score false.

predictions.theory_scope: The fixed output-counter oracle is exact only for the frozen finite LTS, target and count vector; it does not reproduce the source paper's full algorithm or complexity claim.
required_evidence: ordinary target BFS
bounded augmented-state BFS
fixed recorder count equality at the target
separate shortest ordinary and fixed-count witnesses
predictions.falsifier: The ordinary target is unreachable, the fixed count target is unreachable, or the two quantifiers are not reported separately.
predictions.scoring_rule: Score true exactly when ordinary and fixed-count reachability are both true and their independently reconstructed shortest witnesses are both reported; otherwise score false.

predictions.theory_scope: Only the three externally supplied SMS-derived integer inequalities are evaluated; no SMS enumeration, minimal marking, IMS necessity, or iff threshold is claimed.
required_evidence: finite-capacity S3PR or ENS3PR applicability declaration
external SMS-derived provenance
exact integer evaluation of all three inequalities
predictions.falsifier: Any supplied inequality is violated, its capacity variable is absent, or the declared applicability/provenance gate fails.
predictions.scoring_rule: Score true exactly when the applicability and provenance gates pass and all three frozen integer inequalities evaluate true; otherwise score false.

predictions.theory_scope: Optimality is restricted to the supplied candidate monitors; the independent exact finite-LTS supervisor is reported as a baseline without claiming B05 P-semiflow or MCPP reproduction.
required_evidence: complete frozen finite LTS
disjoint legal and first-met bad state sets
exhaustive subset search over exactly three supplied candidates
independent greatest-nonblocking finite-LTS supervisor
predictions.falsifier: A one-monitor legal-preserving cover exists, the lexicographic optimum is not m_alpha plus m_beta, or the candidate set cannot cover every first-met bad state.
predictions.scoring_rule: Score true exactly when exhaustive subset search selects m_alpha and m_beta as the unique lexicographically tie-broken minimum legal-preserving cover and the independent supervisor baseline completes; otherwise score false.

predictions.theory_scope: Ten exact generator cells jointly test directionality, capacity, AGV count, WIP, route mix and rates; reachability is decided only after freeze by complete enumeration.
required_evidence: deterministic materialization of all ten cells
complete stable-LTS enumeration at each frozen bound
case-derived absorbing CTMC for every nontruncated cell
reported refusal rather than extrapolation for any truncated cell

G02_REV_DAG.rationale: the reversed one-direction resource acquisition is also acyclic

G03_BALANCED_TIGHT.rationale: opposed routes can retain an AGV-buffer bundle while waiting for an occupied destination machine

G04_BALANCED_AGV2.rationale: two opposed transfers can consume both AGVs while retaining their destination waits

G05_BALANCED_BUFFER2.rationale: the blocking witness needs one unit of each directional buffer, so capacity two does not remove it

G06_BALANCED_MACHINE2.rationale: two jobs per direction can saturate the two-unit destination machine while an AGV-bearing transfer waits

G07_BALANCED_LOW_WIP.rationale: one job per direction suffices for the opposed BAS hold-and-request witness

G08_FORWARD_SKEW.rationale: one reverse job remains sufficient to close the asymmetric forward-heavy witness

G09_FAST_RELEASE.rationale: release rate changes probability but not the support of the stable transition graph

G10_SLOW_TRANSFER.rationale: transfer rate changes probability but not the support of the stable transition graph

predictions.falsifier: Any complete nontruncated cell enumeration disagrees with its expected_reachable_closed_core boolean, or generator/rate materialization differs from the frozen cell.
predictions.scoring_rule: Score the case true only if all ten cell booleans agree with complete nontruncated enumeration; report the ten-cell agreement count separately and score false if any cell truncates or disagrees.

predictions.theory_scope: An independently named three-island BAS model with three route classes tests whether AGV and finite output buffers are indispensable to the certificate and quantitative risk.
required_evidence: deterministic materialization of ABG, BAG and AG work orders
complete stable-LTS enumeration within 32768 states
certificate retaining every indispensable transport resource
case-derived absorbing CTMC with frozen event rates
predictions.falsifier: The generator omits a declared route/resource, the LTS truncates, no transport-inclusive core is reachable, or the quantitative generator is not derived from the enumerated case.
predictions.scoring_rule: Score true exactly when materialization is exact, complete enumeration is nontruncated, at least one reachable minimal core contains AGV or finite-buffer resources, and the CTMC provenance binds to that LTS; otherwise score false.

predictions.theory_scope: The exact generated target attacks simple-cycle and S4PR reductions with OR-of-AND alternatives, multi-capacity fixtures, AGVs and persistent reservation resources; it is a snapshot claim, not a reachability claim.
required_evidence: deterministic generator materialization
capacity-aware closed-blocking-kernel certificate
preservation of both OR alternatives and each AND clause
explicit refusal of unsupported S4PR or simple-cycle equivalence
predictions.falsifier: The target has an enabled request alternative, lacks a capacity-aware closed core, or a claimed reduction removes AGV/reservation semantics without changing the classification.
predictions.scoring_rule: Score true exactly when the generated snapshot has no enabled request alternative, yields a capacity-aware closed core, preserves every OR-of-AND clause, and unsupported reductions are explicitly refused; otherwise score false.
